top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Listed (26 TAC §HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - No)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Regular care is being provided to 2 unrelated children.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: No diaper changing tables wwere observed in the infant and toddler's rooms.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Playground check sheets were not available.

top_violation_types.title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current training for children under 24 months of age.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two Epi Pens were located in the child's backpack. One backpack was in the hall accessible to children. One backpack was hanging on a hook in a classroom accessible to children.  This was corrected at inspection when the Epi-Pens were removed from the backpacks and placed in a cabinet where is was inaccessible to children.
